source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
While your **FORTIFICATIONS** are the only units from your army within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of an enemy unit:

- Ranged attacks can still target that enemy unit, but each one not made with a **[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** gets -1 to the **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**.
- When that enemy unit [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while **Battle-shocked**, its models skip **[Desperate Escape tests](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)**, apart from any whose path takes them over enemy models.
